title: Interview guide
lead: From download to your first question: here's what happens, step by step.
mobileNote: Interviews run on a computer. Open this page there to get the desktop app.

download.title: Install the desktop app
download.body: Interviews run only in the LetsHyre desktop app, so the session stays secure.

signIn.title: Sign in to the app
signIn.body: Use the same email and password as here. Your profile photo and results come with you.

dashboard.title: Start from your dashboard
dashboard.body: Select Take interview. The app checks your computer before anything else opens.

clearEnv.title: Close other apps
clearEnv.body: Browsers, screen recorders, AI assistants and video-call apps must be closed before you can go on.
clearEnv.tip: Quit them from the menu bar or system tray too, not just their windows.

permissions.title: Allow camera, microphone and screen
permissions.body: All three are needed for proctoring. Allow each one when your computer asks.

verifyId.title: Confirm it's you
verifyId.body: Read a short line aloud, then the camera takes a photo to compare with your profile photo.
verifyId.tip: Face the camera in a well-lit room.

chooseRole.title: Choose the role
chooseRole.body: Pick the role you're interviewing for. It starts with the one from your profile.

begin.title: Begin
begin.body: The interview opens full screen with recording on. Answer each question within its time; you can move between questions until the timer ends.
